## schlote-letter-1906.pdf

Letter from Ernst Schlote, a locksmith working in Tsingtao (Qingdao) for the Prussian railway workshop Leinhausen, to his fiancée Maria Lüdeke in Linden bei Hannover, dated Lifang, 10 June 1906. One folded sheet of squared paper, four pages written in German Kurrent script; pages 3 and 4 add Chinese numerals in ink. The form pages describe the letter; the scans are page 1, pages 2 and 3 (double page) and page 4.

Source: scans by Bernd Schwabe (Wikipedia Hannover) of the original lent by a private owner, published on Wikimedia Commons:

- [Brief Seite 1](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1906-06-10_Ernst_Schlote_handschriftlicher_Brief_aus_Tsingtao_(Lifang)_an_Frl._Maria_L%C3%BCdeke_in_Linden_bei_Hannover,_Marktplatz_12,_Brief_Seite_1.jpg)
- [Brief Seite 2 und 3](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1906-06-10_Ernst_Schlote_handschriftlicher_Brief_aus_Tsingtao_(Lifang)_an_Frl._Maria_L%C3%BCdeke_in_Linden_bei_Hannover,_Marktplatz_12,_Brief_Seite_2_und_3.jpg)
- [Brief Seite 4](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1906-06-10_Ernst_Schlote_handschriftlicher_Brief_aus_Tsingtao_(Lifang)_an_Frl._Maria_L%C3%BCdeke_in_Linden_bei_Hannover,_Marktplatz_12,_Brief_Seite_4.jpg)

License: the scans are released under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (as stated on the file pages, retrieved 2026-10-20); the letter itself (1906) is in the public domain. The PDF uses the 1920 px versions, recompressed as JPEG. The form entries are taken from the Commons descriptions and from the scans; the document ID is made up.
